response.explanation: At line 11, src/presentation/app.ts imports `createRepositories` from src/persistence/repositories.ts. The only place it uses it is line 21, inside `buildApp`, where it builds the repository set and passes it into the business services (TeamService, PlayerService, RefereeService, FixtureService, PitchService, TableService and WeatherService, lines 22-28). None of the route handlers in the visible code (lines 33-60) call a repository directly; they all go through the services. So this is wiring code that happens to live in the Express app module, not data access from the presentation layer. FF-S03 still flags it because the presentation layer's dependency on persistence skips the business layer between them, and the strict layering is meant to block exactly that kind of compile-time dependency. Line 10 creates the same kind of dependency on src/persistence/gateways, but this finding covers only the edge at line 11. No docs, ADRs or comments were provided that call app.ts a composition root or allow it to reach into persistence.
